（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. File No. D 4809.）

Subject (in full) Prosecution of Kai Lai Sung (干蘭蓀), Editor
of the Shanghai Daily News.

Made by D.S. Sansom Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

As the result of publishing an article in the
Shanghai Daily News on May 3, 1933, which was detrimental
to the Public Order, the editor of that paper, named
Kai Lai Sung, was sentenced on the 15/5/33 to a fine of
$100 or 50 days detention, with sentence suspended for
2 years.

The charge originally specified against the
defendant was amended at the direction of the Legal
Staff to that of publishing articles contrary to Art
160, Sec. 1, of the C.C.R.C. Art. 19, Sec. "C", and
Art 45 of the New Press Laws.

Of the two laws cited in the Charge, the C.C.R.C.
provides for the heavier punishment, namely; imprisonment
of not more than 2 years, or detention, or a fine of not
more than $1000.00. In passing the sentence, the Judge recorded
that Article 160, Sec.1 of the C.C.R.C. had been applied.

When compared with the maximum sentence inflictible,
and in view of 5 previous convictions against the defendant
- two of which incurred fines of $200.00 for publishing
indecent advertisements - the sentence meted out on the
15/5/33 appears to be rather a lenient one, and one in
which the anti-Japanese aspect of the objectionable act
seems to have had a particular bearing.

No appeal against the decision has been made.

（批：As a deterrent, the sentence is totally inadequate but, taking into consideration the "patriotic" nature of the case, there would be little likelihood of an offence recurring.）

Officer i/c Special Branch.

完整事由：起诉《上海日报》编辑干蘭蓀（Kai Lai Sung）。

制作人：D.S. Sansom 转呈人：Thos Robertson，警司。

由于在1933年5月3日的《上海日报》上刊登了一篇危害公共秩序的文章，该报编辑干蘭蓀（Kai Lai Sung）于1933年5月15日被判处罚金100元或拘留50天，缓刑两年。

最初针对被告指定的指控，经法律部门指示，修改为违反《中华民国刑法》第160条第1款、第19条“C”款以及《新新闻法》第45条，刊登文章之罪。

在指控中引用的两项法律中，《中华民国刑法》规定了较重的刑罚，即：不超过两年的监禁，或拘留，或不超过1000.00元的罚款。法官在宣判时记录称，已适用《中华民国刑法》第160条第1款。

与可施加的最高刑期相比，并考虑到被告此前有五次定罪记录——其中两次因刊登淫秽广告被处以200.00元罚款——1933年5月15日所判处的刑罚似乎相当宽大，且该判决似乎特别考虑了该不当行为的反日性质。

未对该决定提出上诉。

（批注：作为威慑，该判决完全不足，但考虑到案件的“爱国”性质，再犯的可能性很小。）

THE CASE OF THE "SHANGHAI DAILY NEWS"

The "Shanghai Daily News", a mosquito paper,
published the following notices in its paper on May 16, 1933.-

1) Comments made by this paper have hitherto been
just and proper, we have always been plain speaking On
April 26 we published an article under the heading: "The
anniversary of the Japanese Emperor's birthday is approaching
soon." The wording of the article was quite strong but
we were moved by patriotic enthusiasm to speak out for weak
and small races and we had no other motive The Intelligence
Office of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai has expressed
the opinion that although the article had been written
out of our patriotism, its tenure was liable to affect the
peace and good order of this locality and it tendered us
a warning. Soon afterwards the Shanghai Municipal Police
prosecuted Kan Lan Sun, 干蘭生 publisher of this paper.
in the Shanghai Special District Court on a charge of
menacing the peace and good order of this locality The
Japanese community in Shanghai were also displeased with
the article. Thus a "Great Wave" was caused and we have
had to suffer suspension of our publication for half a month.
The Municipality of Greater Shanghai now realizes (? under-
stands our motive) while the Court has delivered its
Decision. Commencing from to-day we shall resume
publication Hereafter we shall make reforms and publish
more reading material and struggle continually with the
same spirit as before.
(Translator's note - This article appears to
have been written deliberately in an ambiguous and
evasive manner and in disjointed sentences.)

2) Kan Lan Sun being very busy. has tendered his
resignation. Hereafter Zia Pau 謝豹 and Toong E Mung, 童綺華
Editors of this paper, will undertake full responsibility
for all matters published by this paper.

3) Commencing from to-day I, Kan Lan Sun. owing
to pressure of time to deal with private matters, have
severed my connection with the "Shanghai Daily News".
I have reported this matter to the Government organs
concerned and asked for a change in the name of the
responsible person of the paper. I now publish this
notice for public information.

Min Pao publishes the following comments:-

THE SUPPRESSION OF YOUNG PROSTITUTES.

We express our sympathy to the China Youths
Philanthropic Federation in its letter to the S.M.C.
requesting it to suppress young prostitutes.
How will the young prostitutes live when they are
strictly prohibited to lead this immoral life? This is a
serious question.
We would suggest that the suppression of young
prostitutes be carried out at the same time that they be
given training for some kind of work.

《上海日报》案

《上海日报》是一家微不足道的小报，于1933年5月16日在该报刊登了以下通告：

1) 本报迄今发表的评论公正得当，我们一直直言不讳。4月26日，我们发表了一篇题为：“日本天皇诞辰纪念日即将来临”的文章。文章措辞相当激烈，但我们出于爱国热情，为弱小球族发声，别无其他动机。大上海市政府情报处表示意见认为，虽然该文章是出于我们的爱国心而写，但其内容可能影响本地区的和平与良好秩序，并向我们发出警告。不久之后，上海公共租界工部局警务处在上海特区地方法院起诉本报出版人干蘭生（Kan Lan Sun），指控其威胁本地区的和平与良好秩序。上海日本侨民社区也对该文章感到不满。因此引起了一场“大风波”，我们不得不遭受停刊半个月的处罚。大上海市政府现在意识到（？理解我们的动机），而法院也已作出裁决。从今天起，我们将恢复出版。此后我们将进行改革，刊登更多阅读材料，并以与以前相同的精神继续奋斗。
（译者注——这篇文章似乎是故意以模棱两可、回避的方式写成，且句子支离破碎。）

2) 干蘭生（Kan Lan Sun）因事务繁忙，已提出辞职。此后，本报编辑谢豹（Zia Pau）和童綺華（Toong E Mung）将对本报刊登的所有事项承担全部责任。

3) 从今天起，我，干蘭生（Kan Lan Sun），因处理私人事务时间紧迫，已切断与《上海日报》的联系。我已向有关政府机关报告此事，并申请变更报纸负责人姓名。现发布此通告以告公众。

《民报》发表以下评论：

取缔年轻妓女。

我们对中华青年慈善联合会在致工部局的信中请求取缔年轻妓女表示同情。
当严格禁止年轻妓女从事这种不道德的生活时，她们将如何生存？这是一个严重的问题。
我们建议在取缔年轻妓女的同时，对她们进行某种工作的培训。

Shun Pao:-

PHILIPPINES HEALTH OFFICER TO INVESTIGATE HAM
PRODUCTS IN CHINA.

"Fu Ka Tek", Chief of the Philippines Health
Department, arrived in Shanghai some time ago to investigate
into the sanitation of ham factories in China. He considers
that the process for the curing of ham has greatly improved.
He will proceed to Tsingtao and will return on April 29.
He will later investigate the ham factories in Jukao, Ching
Hwa and Lanchi.
It is expected that the Philippines embargo on
Chinese hams may be removed, after his return to the
Philippines.

Shun Pao:-

CHINESE STYLE DOCTORS OPPOSE TAX ON PRESCRIPTIONS.

The ShangHai District Chinese Style Doctors
Institute will collect a fee of 1 cent for every
prescription from Chinese style doctors for the expenses
of the Institute.
As the Institute is not a Government organ, such
a levy is being regarded as unlawful by the Chinese style
doctors.
At a meeting held by 60 doctors some days ago,
it was resolved that the levy be opposed, but subscriptions

year, just after they had succeeded in their invasion
of Shanghai, they celebrated the festival in the
Hongkew Park. Unexpectedly Yun Bong Gil, a Korean
hero, threw a bomb, the explosion of which had
successful results. All the persons who stood on the
platform were unable to escape. Kawabata was killed
instantaneously. Shirakawa succumbed to his injuries
soon afterwards. One of the legs of Shigemitsu was
amputated. Nomura was blinded. A number of other

a great blow to the Japanese invaders; their happy
festival had been transformed into a tragedy.
Time passes very quickly and April 29
is only three days off. During the past year, the
Japanese imperialists invaded the North, captured
Chingchow, Jehol, Shanhaikwan, etc. and lately
invaded the Great Wall.
Owing to the approach of their festival,
the dwarf slaves are madly making preparations for
celebration. However, we should also make
preparations. What should our preparations be? We
should realize that there will be no Yun Bong Gil this
year to work for us. We must take revenge ourselves.
Korea had Yun Bong Gil. Is China not able to produce
a man like Yun Bong Gil? I hope that during this
year's festival a more exciting performance will be
staged by a Chinese citizen. Patriots should make
preparations now.

他们每年举行的庆祝活动比我们的双十节更为热烈。去年的那一天，就在他们成功入侵上海后，他们在虹口公园庆祝节日。出乎意料的是，朝鲜英雄尹奉吉投掷了一枚炸弹，爆炸取得了成功的效果。站在台上的所有人都无法逃脱。川岛（Kawabata）当场死亡。白川（Shirakawa）不久后因伤身亡。重光（Shigemitsu）的一条腿被截肢。野村（Nomura）双目失明。其他数名矮奴也受伤。这一事件对日本侵略者是一个沉重打击；他们快乐的节日变成了悲剧。
时光飞逝，4月29日仅剩三天。在过去的一年里，日本帝国主义入侵北方，占领了锦州、热河、山海关等地，最近又入侵长城。
由于他们的节日临近，矮奴们正疯狂地准备庆祝。然而，我们也应该做好准备。我们应该做什么准备？我们应该意识到今年不会有尹奉吉为我们效力。我们必须自己报仇。韩国有尹奉吉。中国难道不能产生一个像尹奉吉那样的人吗？我希望在今年的节日期间，由中国公民上演一场更激动人心的表演。爱国者们现在应该做好准备。
